correctness.rationale: The unitary scaling fixes modulation step 1, with a=2/3 and eta=gamma/b. Modulation Parseval and the 3-residue/2-block Fourier fiber give a 2-by-2 positive Gram matrix, whose trace and determinant are exact. Its eigenvalue extrema occur at Fourier phase zero and opposite endpoints of x in (0,1/3). Global minimization uses an exact polynomial identity and one palindromic root in u in (0,1), plus infinite endpoint divergence. The supplemental checker independently verifies algebra and geometric Fourier sums (4,617 assertions); no infinite claim rests on a finite grid.

value.rationale: The first reduced noninteger density 3/2 produces a genuinely coupled rational-lattice fiber where the well-studied integer oversampling scalar formulas are inapplicable. Exact sharp frame bounds and unique global lattice conditioning matter for waveform/frame design and provide a natural benchmark for future rational-density optimization; the radical sqrt(65) and finite-condition optimum are not merely a routine restatement of a qualitative frame-set theorem.
